home.intro: Qualia Typo is an independent art magazine made entirely by young volunteers. Each volume gathers writing, illustration and experimental design around a single theme.

about.title: About Qualia Typo
body: PLACEHOLDER: Qualia Typo began as a small idea between friends who wanted somewhere to put their work — somewhere without algorithms and without deadlines.
PLACEHOLDER: Every issue is built around a theme chosen collectively. Members contribute writing, photography, collage and illustration, and the whole group edits it together.
PLACEHOLDER: The magazine is free in digital form. Read it online, or download it and print your own copy.

group.title: About us
body: PLACEHOLDER: The Qualia Art Youth Group is a voluntary collective of young people working across visual art, writing and design.
PLACEHOLDER: We run horizontally and without funding. If you would like to take part in a future issue, get in touch.
